title: ManiOS 0.26.0 DOS compatibility retest

build.environment: QEMU i386 10.0.13, CPU 486, 64 MiB RAM, serial console; fresh disposable FAT16 copy per case; 8-12 s observation limit

method: Each case copies the source FAT16 image, boots QEMU 486/64 MiB with the 0.26.0 kernel, runs one command from the ManiOS shell, captures the serial transcript and a screen dump, and exports any generated files with mtools for byte comparison. Windows setup writes to its disposable copy; every other copy is also writable but observed only.
